summary: Volaris filed a routine Form 6-K furnishing its September 2026 preliminary traffic results under US disclosure rules for foreign private issuers via press release. Total RPMs rose 3.1% year over year with consolidated load factor up 1.0 point to 84.4%; capacity increased 1.9%. International RPMs grew 14.2% while domestic RPMs fell 3.8%. Management noted moderated capacity during the month, down 22% from summer peak, supporting load factors and unit revenues. No transaction, terms, board recommendation, advisors, or structural mechanics disclosed; no deal terms stated.
